PREPARED WALKTHROUGH

A quick look at BearRok

The video shows a prepared student feed. The walkthrough below explains the agent code behind BearRok.

What Grok does behind the feed

GROK · SEARCH + STRUCTURED REASONING

Grok search, with a team behind each result

A single sequential pass handles each phase in turn. Here, managers explore different slices concurrently, and shared URL deduplication limits repeated reading. Separate reviewers check student fit and current source status.

Web search gives the team evidence Scouts find public postings. Extractors read official pages and collect the words and URLs behind eligibility, dates, and application details.

Optional X search adds another lead source When enabled, X search can surface organizer announcements. Workers follow promising leads through the same reading and independent checking steps.

Example student request “I’m a first-year student looking for paid software internships in Berkeley or remote. No events.”

  1. Turn your needs into a brief

    The master reads your profile, background, and feedback. Your notes carry the most weight. If you ask for paid roles and rule out events, those preferences become criteria for every manager.

  2. Divide the search across four managers

    Four search managers can look for internships in parallel. They divide the work by field, employer, location, or source and send small jobs to a shared worker queue.

  3. Find leads and read the source

    Grok scouts search the web. Extractors open organizer or employer pages and collect details with quotes and URLs. Scouts can also search X for leads when X search is enabled. The default configuration uses web search.

  4. Check fit and check whether it is open

    Two reviewers make separate judgments. One checks whether the role meets this student’s criteria. The other checks whether the posting is real and open. A senior-only or closed role is rejected. Dates must have evidence. When no current page states a deadline, it stays unknown.

  5. Give the student a useful next step

    The presentation manager explains why a kept role fits. Application readers collect prompts and materials. A suitable paid remote internship can reach the feed with its apply link and supporting details. Saves, likes, and dislikes guide the next run.
